app_name: BRADERS - Churros Lezatoss POS & Business Management
personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (Customized with Warm Cream, Brown, Golden Yellow, and White palette)
personality_one_liner: A high-speed, touch-friendly, and delightful POS and business management app for the churros brand BRADERS with warm cream, brown, and golden yellow aesthetics.

spacing.rule: Generous touch-friendly padding with comfortable vertical rhythm, compact 8px spacing for dense POS grids and 16px/24px padding for dashboards and forms.

do's: Use translucent sticky headers and bottom cart sheets over scrolling content
Apply glass blur with warm cream tinted base for QRIS modal overlays
dont's: Never blur dense POS product grid cards or input fields

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of today's sales, gross/net profit, expenses, cash balance, low stock alerts, and quick actions in Bahasa Indonesia.

states.loading: Centered warm spinner with logo badge
states.empty: Illustration + 'Belum ada transaksi hari ini' + 'Mulai POS'

screens.layout: Vertical scroll with top sticky header, greeting & shift status card, 2x2 KPI metric grid (Penjualan, Keuntungan, Pengeluaran, Kas), Sales & Profit trend interactive chart card, Low stock warning banner, and Quick Actions row.

screens.name: POS / Kasir
screens.purpose: Lightning-fast cashier product grid, category tabs, cart management with quantity/discount/customer, change calculation, and QRIS QR code checkout.

states.empty: Cart is empty illustration + 'Pilih produk churros di atas'

screens.layout: Split or tabbed view optimized for touch: left/top category pills and fast-scrolling product grid with real photo cards and price tags, bottom sticky slide-up cart sheet with discount, customer select, and QRIS/Cash checkout buttons.

screens.name: Pesanan (Orders)
screens.purpose: Order history, receipt viewing, and void/cancel management with role restrictions.

states.empty: No orders yet illustration + 'Belum ada riwayat pesanan'

screens.layout: Filter tabs (Semua, Selesai, Dibatalkan), searchable list of order cards showing order ID, customer name, items summary, payment method badge (QRIS/Tunai), status, and action buttons for receipt reprint or void.

screens.name: Produk & Resep (Products)
screens.purpose: Product catalogue CRUD, recipe BOM ingredients breakdown, and HPP (Harga Pokok Penjualan) estimate calculation.
screens.layout: List of churros and drinks with thumbnail image, selling price, HPP cost, profit margin badge, and quick edit/recipe modal trigger.

screens.name: Inventaris (Inventory)
screens.purpose: Ingredient stock tracking, min stock threshold, stock valuation, movement history, and low stock warnings.
screens.layout: Inventory dashboard summary (Total nilai stok, Barang kritis), searchable ingredient cards with stock status badge, current quantity vs min stock, and stock adjustment buttons.

screens.name: Pembelian (Purchases)
screens.purpose: Record stock-in purchases from suppliers, ingredient costs, and purchase history.
screens.layout: Chronological list of purchase orders with supplier name, total cost, items received, and 'Tambah Pembelian' floating action button.

screens.name: Pengeluaran (Expenses)
screens.purpose: Track operational expenses categorized by rent, utilities, staff pay, marketing, and raw materials.
screens.layout: Monthly expense breakdown summary card, category filter pills, and list of expense items with date, amount in IDR, and receipt note.

screens.name: Laporan Keuangan & Penjualan (Reports)
screens.purpose: Comprehensive financial statements (Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Opex, Net Profit) and sales analytics by best sellers, category, and hour.

states.empty: No report data for selected date range

screens.layout: Date range picker filter header, financial summary cards, Profit & Loss statement breakdown, best sellers ranking list, and payment method distribution chart.

screens.name: Marketing & Promosi (Marketing)
screens.purpose: Create and manage active promotions, discount vouchers, and loyalty programs for BRADERS customers.
screens.layout: List of active/expired promo discount cards with discount percentage, minimum purchase, validity period, and toggle switch.

screens.name: Pelanggan (Customers)
screens.purpose: Customer database tracking total spending, visit frequency, and loyalty points for BRADERS fans.
screens.layout: Searchable customer directory with avatar/initials, phone number, total spend in IDR, visit count, and loyalty tier badge.

screens.name: Kasir Shift (Cash Register)
screens.purpose: Open and close shift management, recording expected vs actual cash in the register drawer.
screens.layout: Shift status banner, opening cash input, cash in/out drawer transactions log, closing cash reconciliation form (expected vs actual cash difference calculation).

screens.name: Pengaturan & Pengguna (Settings)
screens.purpose: Business profile settings (BRADERS Churros Lezatoss), receipt printer config, tax/service fee settings, and User roles (Owner, Cashier, Staff).
screens.layout: Grouped settings sections (Profil Bisnis, Perangkat Kasir & Printer, Pengguna & Hak Akses dengan Role-based access), with toggle switches and save actions.

hero_churros.alt: Freshly made churros dusted with powdered sugar and chocolate dip

churros_box.alt: Close-up of hand holding churros with chocolate sauce in BRADERS packaging

churros_tray.alt: Tray of churros wrapped in paper with a bowl of chocolate sauce

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the full-stack business management and POS application 'BRADERS' ('Churros Lezatoss') using React Native, Expo Router, and TypeScript. Adhere strictly to the warm cream (#FAF6ED), brown (#2C1810), golden yellow (#D97706), and white color palette. Ensure the POS cashier screen is extremely fast, responsive, and touch-optimized with category filters, a product grid with real photo cards, cart drawer with discount/customer selection, and an interactive QRIS checkout simulation with countdown and status polling. Implement all 12 core modules in Bahasa Indonesia with IDR Rupiah currency formatting. Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt and all screens include loading, empty, and error states. Use bottom navigation for mobile with clear icons.
